name: OpenVibe.Reviews
notes: Entities with aliases and typed links; resolution of OpenVibe.Sources review items by deterministic rules (source binding, URL, GTIN/SKU/MPN) with editor confirmation for name-only and conflicting matches; merges that rewrite nothing and splits that restore attribution exactly, both audited; typed signals with provenance (source item, item revision, retrieval time, licence note) and trust metadata; aggregates computed only from signals present (method reviews-aggregate@1, inputs and exclusions exposed, absent without qualifying signals, a new revision on every change); editor-written or AI-drafted-and-approved summaries whose points cite signals and never carry a rating; source removal withdraws signals, flags citing summaries and prepares a pending revision; corrections queue; Community discussion referenced, not copied. Server-rendered pages useful without JavaScript; AggregateRating/Product/Review JSON-LD only when signals back it; sitemaps, feeds and Search index events from the openvibe-publishing v0.2.0 gate. Not deployed; openvibe.reviews stays on OpenVibe.Sites until launch.
